rationale: Identity was verified correctly using full name + zip. The agent reviewed orders and product variants appropriately and executed exchanges that matched the user’s intents (bike to a larger frame; camera to lower resolution while keeping other options). However, there are critical policy violations: (1) The agent performed a write (bike exchange) without first stating the exact change and obtaining explicit confirmation. (2) For the camera exchange, the agent did not state the exact replacement variant or price/refund details and still proceeded after only a general go-ahead. (3) The user explicitly preferred Visa for payment/refund; the agent used the Mastercard (payment_method_id credit_card_8105988) for both exchanges, ignoring the stated preference. (4) Although the tool blocked a second exchange in the same order (post-exchange status no longer delivered), the agent’s explanation was acceptable, but they should have proposed alternatives or clarified constraints before attempting the write. The skateboard cancellation was left to the user as requested. Due to the unconfirmed writes and wrong payment method, the conversation fails the pass bar.
